$comment: The hub's design tokens (issue #39): every color, text size, corner
radius and spacing the UI uses, in ONE place. Read by:
- linux_a7/ui_layer (src/theme.rs, compiled in): applies the chosen
preset to the Slint `Theme` global at run time, no restart;
- the Flutter app (#48), so phone and hub look alike.
A preset = mode (a palette) + accent + density; see the wiki's
Design-System page. Sizes are in logical pixels.
Change a value here, not in a .slint file: no component may contain
$comment-accents: Each accent has a shade for each mode: a light one on the dark background, a darker one on the light background, so it keeps its contrast. on-accent: the text color ON an accent-colored surface (a primary button).
$comment-density: comfortable: finger-sized, for the touchscreen. compact: more on screen, for a mouse on a monitor (still tappable, just tighter).
$comment-splash: The boot image and the UI's welcome screen (issue #59). Fixed, whatever the chosen preset: the welcome screen must match the boot image U-Boot shows, pixel for pixel.
$comment-auto: Mode "auto": light between these hours, hub-local time (the hub's time zone setting), dark otherwise.
